brand.name: Laurel
brand.shortPitch: Wood-fired pizza, hand-rolled pasta and a short, honest wine list. Logan Square, seven days a week.

hero.sub: Wood-fired pizza, hand-rolled pasta and cold drinks in a room that gets loud on purpose. Order pickup in about 20 minutes, or grab a table and make a night of it.

story.heading: A kitchen that acts like a
body: Laurel started in 2021 with one oven, four tables and a rule we still keep: nobody gets rushed. We fire pizza at 800 degrees, roll pasta every morning, and buy from growers we can drive to.
The room is loud, the lights are warm and the playlist is somebody's actual mixtape. Come in a sweatshirt. Bring the baby. Stay for one more.

faq.q: How far ahead should we book?
faq.a: Two weeks is comfortable. December fills up by Halloween.
Yes. No cutting fee, and we will plate it for you.
Tell us the count and we build the menu around it. Gluten free, vegetarian and vegan are easy here.
Half the food minimum holds the date, and it comes off the final bill.

visit.heading: Two blocks from the
visit.transit: California stop on the Blue Line, then a four-minute walk. The 56 and the 73 stop at the corner.
visit.parking: Free lot next door after 5pm, metered on Milwaukee, and permit-free on Fullerton after 6.
visit.access: Step-free entry, an accessible restroom, service animals welcome, and large-print menus at the host stand. Tell us what you need and we will make it work.
visit.dogs: Dogs are welcome on the patio and get a bowl of water without asking.

faq.a: Yes, for parties of one to six, up to 30 days out. The bar and the patio are kept for walk-ins every night.

faq.q: How late does the kitchen run?
faq.a: The kitchen stops 30 minutes before close. The bar keeps going until the lights come up.

Most dishes can be made gluten free or dairy free, and the kitchen keeps a separate prep area. Tell your server, or add a note to your online order. Our fryer is shared, so it is not safe for severe allergies.
There is, and kids eat free on Sundays with any adult entree.
